notes: I fit a cubic polynomial to the E1 data. The dominant term is clearly ≈ -3.9·x³ (ratios y/x³ are consistently ≈ -3.90 for large |x|), with small quadratic and linear corrections needed to match the small-|x| points (x=2.9 and x=-6 deviate noticeably from pure -3.9·x³). The fit is approximate — there may be a piecewise region or a different functional form I haven't pinned down, so I've marked this
